en: Q3 Architectural Specialties sales rose 21.5%, including $25m organic growth and $8m acquired growth.
es: Las ventas de Architectural Specialties aumentaron un 21,5% en el tercer trimestre, con $25m de crecimiento orgánico y $8m por adquisiciones.
provenance: Reported issuer results; amounts rounded in company commentary.

en: AWI had $430m of undrawn revolver availability at September 30, 2026; current loan principal was $472.9m.
es: AWI disponía de $430m no utilizados en su línea de crédito al 30 de septiembre de 2026; el principal de los préstamos era de $472,9m.
provenance: Reported Q3 2026 debt and liquidity disclosures; no inference of unrestricted borrowing under all future conditions.

en: Reported WAVE distributions were $113.0m in 2025, supporting historical cash conversion but not certifying future capital coverage.
es: Las distribuciones de WAVE fueron de $113,0m en 2025: respaldan la conversión histórica en caja, pero no certifican la cobertura futura de capital.
provenance: Reported annual distribution amount plus explicit analyst limitation.

en: Nine-month operating cash flow fell from $245.5m to $222.1m as receivable cash use and cash tax payments increased.
es: La caja operativa de nueve meses bajó de $245,5m a $222,1m al aumentar el consumo de caja por cobros pendientes y los pagos fiscales.
provenance: Reported comparative cash-flow statements; cash timing is not assumed permanently impaired.

en: Recent acquisitions contributed $25.1m of nine-month sales but an operating loss of $4.6m, including $3.0m D&A.
es: Las adquisiciones recientes aportaron $25,1m de ventas en nueve meses, pero una pérdida operativa de $4,6m, incluidos $3,0m de depreciación y amortización.

en: WAVE distributions are classified as returns of investment under the cumulative-earnings approach; high payouts do not prove sustainable distributable cash.
es: Las distribuciones de WAVE se clasifican como devolución de inversión mediante el método de beneficios acumulados; un pago elevado no prueba caja distribuible sostenible.
provenance: Reported FY2025 Note 2 classification plus analyst interpretation.

en: The analyst model gives $67.84/$109.50/$164.90 against $171.23. These are conditional scenarios, not an approved valuation or entry.
es: El modelo del analista arroja $67,84/$109,50/$164,90 frente a $171,23. Son escenarios condicionados, no una valoración ni una entrada aprobadas.
provenance: Analyst-derived ten-year core FCFF plus WAVE equity-cash model; market close verified separately.
